scenario.title: Ice Hunter (Moon)
scenario.goal: Map water ice deposits inside Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs) at both lunar poles to support future Artemis surface habitats.
scenario.educationalNote: Unlike Earth, the Moon has no atmosphere to slow satellites down, but lumpy gravity anomalies ('mascons') perturb low orbits unless you pick a stable frozen inclination or carry station-keeping fuel.
